seal_status_note: This records WHICH packages sealed and at which commit. It is NOT a phase PASS: a phase passes only when its exit gate is met, and the exit gates live in the execution pack. Derived from programme/index.json — never hand-typed.

sealed_packages.invariant: no controller path ends in an uncaught throw or an unlawful category crossing
sealed_packages.note: TOC.D crossings 2/3 and the P6.7 rewiring remain on the work order

sealed_packages.invariant: one persisted monotonic run clock; a resume, retry or new turn cannot restore spent budget
sealed_packages.note: STAGE_FLOOR_MS bounded not removed; a non-finite budget now refuses

sealed_packages.invariant: every stage receipt declares the recipe that produced it, and the stage closure is derived from the import graph
sealed_packages.note: 13 hand-named modules where the real closure is 98; RunStore declared dead, its digest helpers made live

sealed_packages.invariant: expensive evidence-half work is a declared graph whose every cache decision records a typed reason
sealed_packages.note: declares and measures but deliberately does not skip; a dishonest key is recorded, not served

sealed_packages.invariant: a change invalidates exactly the work it should, and the reuse a run claims is the reuse it performed
sealed_packages.note: the declared map disagreed with the measured graph on 8 of 12 entries, every one in the unsafe direction

sealed_packages.invariant: concurrency is bounded by declared resource limits and mandatory work has budget priority over optional
sealed_packages.note: the circuit breaker became a real breaker; a missing asset declaration would ship a package the controller needs and no test catches it

sealed_packages.invariant: the performance receipt's spans measure what they are named, reconcile against the total, and checkpoint reuse is a lawful zero
sealed_packages.note: invalid receipt is a typed finding; delivery preserved by design

sealed_packages.invariant: an unfit host is refused before expensive work, with every precondition typed and unknown never rounded up into a pass
sealed_packages.note: found the live Pillow/numpy render-lane gap on this host; controller wiring deferred, CLI ships as an entry point

rollback: tag excel-inflow-v376-evidence-baseline; every package is an atomic commit

approvals.note: Approvals are HUMAN acts. Automation records the facts above; it does not approve a phase. Empty is the truthful state.
